notes.title: 1.05 update
notes.notes:
- Some people were reporting getting "stuck" in Iron Pizza mode.  This has been addressed.\
- Minor typo fixes and tweaks

notes.title: 1.04 update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Controller “keyboard” now hides when you click “No” or “Load”
[*]No longer can see “double” Jay in both the front of the club and sitting w/ Mo
[*]Typos fixed
[*]Fixed issue where you could retrigger “House Mix” quest after completing it
[*]Fixed issue where “Power of the Crowd” quest didn’t leave your journal if you failed to convince dancers to help you
[/list]

Thanks everyone for an awesome launch week!

notes.title: 1.03 update
notes.notes:
Here's a few recent fixes based on user feedback
[list]
[*]Loading saved games now opens a “yes/no” prompt, like save games.  
[*]Lowered the “Adventure” difficulty down to $46 to prevent a possible softlock in the tutorial
Player dice pool expanded to 12.
[*]Elevator SFX in garage finale no longer sounds too loud when master volume is turned down.   It is unlikely that you’ll have that many dice in play, but it’s there just in case.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.02 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Here's a few more bugs squashed 1.02.

[list]
[*] Adjusted wording for Nightclub Management Woes quest so it's clearer.
[*] Burst of music audio should no longer take place when quitting
[*] Fixed “Walk Away” button on dumpster not working if you don’t disable savegame message beforehand
[*] Fixed some camera clipping issues around the security station.
[/list]

notes.title: Post-launch hotfix patch
notes.notes:
Glad to hear everyone's having a good time at Club Low.  Slipped in a hotfix for the weekend:

[list]
[*] Various typos fixed
[*] Text placement adjusted in a few places
[*] Dice texture z-fighting for Linux and Steam Deck users addressed.  If users are still having z-fighting issues, let me know in the forums.
[/list]

You can post any future issues in the Steam forum, through the in-game bug submission button or directly at support-at-cosmod-dot-net.
